name: DWD gridded weather (1 x 1 km)
description: High-resolution gridded meteorological fields for Germany at ~1 km resolution (daily). Used for weather indices, phenology forcing and climate-derived variables.
papers: Timing and intensity of heat and drought stress determine wheat yield losses in Germany
Transparent and Reproducible Crop Model Calibration Using Exclusively Public Data: Improving Phenology and Yield Predictions in APSIMx
Insuring crops from space: the potential of satellite-retrieved soil moisture to reduce farmers' drought risk exposure

name: ESA CCI satellite soil moisture (multi-decadal, ~0.25°)
description: Long-term satellite-retrieved surface soil moisture product (coarse ~0.25°) used to derive drought indices at regional/farm-aggregate scale.
papers: Insuring crops from space: the potential of satellite-retrieved soil moisture to reduce farmers' drought risk exposure

name: SQR soil map (250 x 250 m)
description: Soil survey / soil properties raster at ~250 m resolution used to derive plant-available water (PAW) and soil covariates.
papers: Timing and intensity of heat and drought stress determine wheat yield losses in Germany

name: Soil inventory grid (8 x 8 km)
description: Coarser soil inventory samples used as input for regional APSIMx calibration and soil parameterization.
papers: Transparent and Reproducible Crop Model Calibration Using Exclusively Public Data: Improving Phenology and Yield Predictions in APSIMx

name: High-resolution soil/topography (≈5 m)
description: Fine-scale soil and topographic covariates used for parcel-level erosion nowcasting (slope, curvature, local soil attributes).
papers: Soil-erosion events on arable land are nowcast by machine learning

name: NDVI / optical (Landsat-like, 30 m)
description: Medium-resolution vegetation index time series used as dynamic covariate for erosion nowcasting and vegetation state.
papers: Soil-erosion events on arable land are nowcast by machine learning

name: RapidEye time series (5–6.5 m)
description: High-resolution optical time series used for deriving phenological indicators and optimal acquisition time frames.
papers: Detection of Phenology-Defined Data Acquisition Time Frames For Crop Type Mapping

name: Municipality-level yield dataset (1995–2019)
description: Observed winter-wheat yield time series aggregated to administrative units used for explanatory analysis of heat/drought impacts.
papers: Timing and intensity of heat and drought stress determine wheat yield losses in Germany

name: Aerial erosion observation labels (2011–2012 campaign)
description: Field-parcel level training and validation labels for erosion occurrence and severity derived from aerial flight campaigns.
papers: Soil-erosion events on arable land are nowcast by machine learning
